items.prompt: What is the place value of 5 in 5,432?
Write five thousand four hundred and thirty two in figures.
The same data about the number of pupils who walk to school is shown in a pictograph and in a bar graph. Name one thing that is the same in the two graphs and one thing that is different.
items.answer: Same: both show the same number for each group of pupils. Different: the pictograph uses symbols and a key, the bar graph uses bars and a scale.

items.prompt: Two bar graphs show the same data. One has its vertical scale starting at 0 and the other starts at 40. Explain why the two graphs look different even though the data are the same.
items.answer: Starting the scale at 40 cuts off the lower part, so the bars for 40 or more pupils all look tall and the differences look bigger than they really are.
